query: what was the duration of the nightly-full-analytics-db backup job?
notes: CCR: the nightly-full-analytics-db job's duration must be reconstructable at a tight ~10% budget. All 32 rows share the 'backup-agent job=... status=completed duration=...s size=...GB checksum=...' template, each with its own unique-looking checksum. At the loosest 0.5 ceiling frequency and llmlingua_style still retain the row (its job-name and duration tokens are narrowly the rarest), but tightening to 0.25 and then 0.1 drops it from both, because the shrinking budget now only fits a handful of rows and every row's own checksum makes it look equally rare. recency fails at every ceiling since the row sits mid-log. bm25 is the only selector that survives all three ceilings, because it directly matches the query's 'duration' and 'nightly-full-analytics-db' tokens. The manifest=BKM-77410 and ref=RET-2299 ids sit on separate audit lines and are force-kept independent of the selector.
